Build is now clean — exit 0, "0 errors". Two real bugs from the bump, both in `src/`:

- `core/options.js:7` — read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `{ retryCount }`, so it crashed on `.toFixed` of `undefined`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `net/retryPolicy.js:8` — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, and the strict boolean check threw on that. Now treats `undefined` the same as `false` (backoff disabled).

The remaining 8 `WARN DEP0...`/`W1042`/etc. lines are genuine deprecation noise from the dependency bump (e.g. `Buffer()` ctor, `fs.exists`, `crypto.createCipher`) — not build failures, just things worth cleaning up eventually if you want me to address any of them too.
